description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a responsive user layout, including header messages and inner content areas.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template used for rendering.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section within the layout, specifically 'content' here.

methods.name: supply
methods.description: Provides content blocks for placeholders within the layout.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a partial template, in this case 'partials/header/messages'.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the current buffer or content block, indicating end of the current section.
